$comment: The text support-v2-three-way's items carry inline, lifted out of them and given a name a row can pin. The suite predates crates/gym/src/questions.rs, so its items still hold their own copy and its digest still covers them; this file is the same text under an id, and a test asserts the two agree.

A reword is a new file with a new id, not an edit to this one. The digest covers the questions and nothing else, so a reworded set is a different question set against the same suite, which is the comparison openagents#9386 exists to make expressible.
The routing question is the one docs/text-optimization.md names: one six-word sentence and three criteria strings, never measured.

routing.instructions: Which team should handle this message?

criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, refunds, and payment problems
criteria.sales: Quotes, plans, upgrades, renewals, and pricing

severity.instructions: How severe is the reported issue?

urgency.instructions: Does this need urgent attention today?

criteria.true: Something is broken, blocked, or unsafe right now
criteria.false: It can wait for the normal queue
